# CV-18 — Quiet hours, pausing and holds

> Branch `t/maciej/cv-18-quiet-holds` · status: built, not landed
> Migration: `supabase/migrations/20261016210000_chat_v2_quiet_hours.sql` · applied to the local stack: no (waiting for its turn; dry-run inside a rolled-back transaction with the chat tests)

## Delivered against the row

- **Quiet hours in Time & region:** `user_preferences.quiet_hours_on / quiet_from / quiet_to` (a range in the person's zone that may cross midnight; a CHECK keeps "on" with a range), written only by `user_op_set_time_region` (key `quiet_hours` = `{on, from, to}`, "HH:MM"; turning on needs a range; from ≠ to; a range left out keeps the saved one), read by `user_time_region`; the guard keeps the columns op-only. All three redefined in place from their live bodies.
- **`time_region__quiet_now(user, at)` → (quiet, back_at)** in the saved zone (UTC when unknown or unreadable).
- **Pausing:** `workspace_members.notices_paused_at`, written only by `workspace_op_pause_notices(ws, paused)` on the caller's own row (a guard trigger keeps direct writes out; API keys refused); `workspace_notice_pauses()` lists your paused workspaces.
- **The gate's rules** (`notice__gate`): drop while paused, on do not disturb (CV-17's `hold` becomes `drop`, as the brief binds), or in quiet hours; hold chat kinds (not the summary) while a Focus run is running in its work phase and seen in the last 3 minutes, any workspace; else send. The break-through list is empty.
- **`BEFORE INSERT` trigger `notice_deliveries_gate`:** every device notice of every module asks the gate; drop writes nothing, hold marks the row `held_for_focus`. Tasks' reminders pass unchanged outside quiet hours.
- **Chat's switches, server-side** (CV-6b's deferral): `chat__notice_switch_on(user, reason)` reads `preferences.notifications.chatDirect | chatMentions | chatAnnouncements | chatEvery` (false = off). `chat__notify_devices` writes no notice for a switched-off reason.
- **`held_at`:** `chat__notify_devices` stamps the Catch up item of a message the gate drops or a switch keeps quiet. `chat__queue_waiting_emails` skips switched-off reasons, and while the person is paused, in quiet hours or on do not disturb it sends nothing and stamps what waits, so nothing emails when the hold ends.
- **Focus ends** (`focus_runs_release_held`, a run leaving `running`; also a running run deleted): that person's held rows are acknowledged and one `chat_focus_summary` ("3 messages while you focused", url `/chat?view=catchup`, the run's workspace) goes through the gate. A failure there never stops Focus from ending.
- **`chat_now`:** `quiet_now`, `back_at`; people in quiet hours are listed.
- **Status changes limited** (CV-17's deferral): 30 sets or clears in 10 minutes (`user_status_changes`, private), `PT429` past it.
- **App:** Time & region model/patch carry `quietHours` (+ `isQuietNow`, pure, as the server reads it); Settings → Preferences → Quiet hours (switch + range, `TimeInput`); the workspace switcher's bell button per workspace (pause/resume, `bell-off` when paused); "Sofia's quiet hours · back 9:00" on the line above the box (`composerHoldLine` → `quietHoursLine`); "3 held until Focus ends" above Catch up's list; Settings' Chat switches now say they turn off notifications and emails.

## Agent's choices (deferred to by Maciej: confirmed for building, may be reconsidered)

- **Do not disturb drops (not holds)** · agent · the brief binds drop for dnd; a held row is only released by a Focus end · rejected: keeping CV-17's hold.
- **Focus holds while the run is running in its work phase and seen in the last 3 minutes** (the same test as "Focusing" in `chat_now`), and the summary comes when the run leaves `running` (pause or end) · agent · what teammates see and what's held agree; a stale device doesn't hold pings · rejected: any running run (a Pomodoro break would hold), a summary at each break.
- **The email job stamps what waits while the gate drops** · agent · "nothing pings at 9:00" (AC3.5) includes the email; held means never emailed · rejected: emailing a backlog when quiet hours end.
- **Switches stamp `held_at` too** · agent · a message whose switch was off never emails, even if the switch is turned back on later · rejected: reading the switch only when the email goes.
- **One summary per run, in the run's workspace**, counting distinct messages still readable · agent · rejected: one per workspace (several summaries for one Focus).
- **Quiet hours live in Settings → Preferences (its Notifications part), not in Time & region** · agent · spec §15 puts them under Notifications; times follow the Time & region zone, named in the group's line · rejected: a second copy in Time & region.
- **Pause is a bell button on each switcher row** (tooltip "Pause notifications from this workspace"; filled `bell-off` while paused) · agent · no frame draws it; the row already has icon buttons (settings, delete) · rejected: a menu item per workspace (the switcher has no per-row menu).
- **"3 held until Focus ends" shows above Catch up's list** (own rows, read every 30 s) · agent · Catch up is where the items wait · rejected: the Focus timer (Tasks' surface).
- **"Back 9:00" is on the reader's clock**; do not disturb's line wins over quiet hours' · agent.
- **Status limit 30 changes / 10 minutes** · agent · each change reaches every teammate live · rejected: a per-minute limit (presets clicked in a row).
- **`chat_reminder` and the summary pass the switches untouched** · agent · you asked for a reminder; the summary is the hold's own notice.

## Gotchas (area: supabase)

- `test.try` runs its SQL and then rolls it back (it's for refusals): writes a later check depends on must use `test.as_user`.
- `pg_temp.recut` edits one at a time: each step must compile on its own (a select list using a join added by a later step fails).

## For later blocks

- **CV-23:** `chat__reopen` still keeps `later_until` (CV-11's open item) and the header count still includes quiet lines; not touched here.
- **CV-21:** a key's own switch: add its reason to `chat__notice_switch_on` (the email job and devices read it there).
- **CV-22 / export:** `user_status_changes` is a rate counter, not personal content (cascades from profiles); quiet hours ride in `user_time_region`.
- **Bell excerpt dates** (CV-11's open item) not touched.
- Any module that wants a kind to break through quiet hours adds it to the gate's list (`p_kind = ANY ('{}')`).

## Manual checklist (step → expect → surface)

- [ ] Settings → Preferences → Quiet hours on, 19:00 → 9:00 → saved; reload keeps it; a second device shows it → web
- [ ] In quiet hours, a teammate DMs you → no notification on desktop or browser; it's in Catch up; no email later → desktop + web
- [ ] Teammate opens your DM during your quiet hours → "Sofia's quiet hours · back 9:00" above the box → web
- [ ] A Tasks reminder during quiet hours → in the bell, no push; outside quiet hours → push as before → web
- [ ] Workspace switcher → bell on a client workspace → paused (bell-off); its messages don't ring, the other workspace's do; counts still fill → desktop
- [ ] Start Focus, get a DM and an @mention → no ring; Catch up shows "2 held until Focus ends"; end Focus → one "2 messages while you focused" → desktop
- [ ] Settings → Chat → Direct messages off → a DM rings nowhere and never emails → web
- [ ] Set your status many times quickly → after 30 in 10 minutes, "You're changing your status too often" → web
